mode: synthetic shadow only for executed acceptance
allocation: integer source-to-destination flow plus per-node per-scenario shortage slacks and scenario CVaR; safe pickup and operator drop caps; total work budget
objective: mean total weighted buffer shortfall + risk_weight*CVaR_alpha(total shortfall) + transfer travel-time proxy*unitweight + positive handling unit cost
routing: exact permutations for selected<=8stops; same vehicle, pickup-before-assigned-delivery, cumulative load0..capacity, service+directed travel+return within min(shift,forecast horizon)
fallback: decrease total movement budget by1 and re-solve until a feasible route or no action; preserve rejected attempts; no global optimality claim for the coupled2-stage heuristic
solver: SciPy1.15.3 milp/HiGHS,integer transfer variables,60sec allocation limit,deterministic smallcases
horizon: terminal inventory target at validated10min deadline, not an ETA-specific stock trajectory; confirm source stock at each actual visit and replan; no physical/counterfactual effect claim
cases: same marginals but changed joint dependence switches CVaR destination
unknown or stale operational metadata reject
success: all acceptance assertions pass, zero constraint violations; positive virtual routing example; no real dispatch
failure: any unsafe result or failed acceptance assertion meansnot_supported; preservelogs
compute: dislab CPU, fixed inputs, no random learning, no GPU requirement, no new API evaluation
outputs: per-station pickup/dropoff/net and donor retention, per-stop ETA/load, unserved buffers/scenario loss, assumptions/gates, dispatch_allowed=false
